public_receiver.initial_scope: Calibrated arrival/CFO/rate at first segment midpoint; not blind acquisition

comparisons: fixed timing with actual local RX sample map
public timing HMM with actual local RX sample map
flat_fixture_order: native emitted full Helper/DATA -> real IF PCM -> native TX ASRC -> paired real white noise -> native RX ASRC -> known RX map downmix -> receiver
channel_fixture_order: native shared stochastic Helper/DATA sampled channel including native thermal noise -> real IF PCM -> RX ASRC only -> known RX map downmix -> receiver

channel_fixture.oscillator_effects: off; timing study control, not full RF uncertainty qualification

outage.representation: valid mask; retained observed values are not replaced by zeros

admission: Always withheld. ASRC colored noise, real PCM image and Helper null remain unqualified. Candidate and log-threshold22 gates are diagnostic only, not reliability estimates.
expansion: Only after first RX-only and independent TX/RX 200-ppm diagnostic meets throughput/no-serious-failure check; no retry-until-pass. 50ppm paired control and helper/holdout/channel expansion require available budget.
